entities.summary: David Edwards is an American professional football guard for the New Orleans Saints of the National Football League (NFL). He has previously played in the NFL for the Los Angeles Rams, with whom he won Super Bowl LVI, and the Buffalo Bills. He played college football for the Wisconsin Badgers.
